# Evaluate the facts nvl72doctor -save-facts captured on a GB10 (sm_121,
# driver 580.173.02, nvcc 13.4) on 2026-10-28 against the GB300 profile.
# The GB10 is not a rack node, so the NVLink, fabric, MNNVL and IMEX checks
# skip. Two checks fail. The NCCL sweep is reported as timed out: the
# binary that made this capture misreported every finished child probe as
# a timeout (a direct run of the probe on the same GPU passed every size).
# The BF16 multimem all-reduce does not assemble (fixed on work/nvl72-tp).

! exec nvl72doctor -facts gb10-dgx.json
stdout '^nvl72doctor: gb300-nvl72 on spark-31db \(linux/arm64\)$'
stdout '^pass driver \[observed\]$'
stdout '^warn gpus \[observed\]$'
stdout 'NVIDIA GB10 is sm_121, not sm_103'
stdout '^skip nvlink gpu0 \[observed\]$'
stdout '^skip mnnvl clique \[observed\]$'
stdout '^skip imex domain \[observed\]$'
stdout '^fail nccl \[executed\]$'
stdout '^skip nccl cross-tray$'
stdout '^pass compile tcgen05_scale_vec_4x sm_103a \[compiled\]$'
stdout '^pass compile tile_bf16 sm_103a \[compiled\]$'
stdout 'shared 0 static \+ 110592 dynamic of 232448'
stdout '^fail compile allreduce_rmsnorm_72 sm_103a \[compiled\]$'
! stdout '^pass nvlink'

# The GB200 profile skips the same checks.
! exec nvl72doctor -profile gb200-nvl72 -facts gb10-dgx.json
stdout 'NVIDIA GB10 is sm_121, not sm_100'

# -json carries the profile, the facts and the checks.
! exec nvl72doctor -json -facts gb10-dgx.json
stdout '"profile": "gb300-nvl72"'
stdout '"name": "nccl cross-tray",'
stdout '"cluster_uuid": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"'
